claim.claim-text: 1. Silica fiber composition for use in treating injured tissue comprising applying the silica fiber composition to said injured tissue without removing a substantial amount of the silica fiber composition from said tissue during and after healing of said tissue.
2. Silica fiber composition for use according to claim 1, wherein the injured tissue is a wound.
3. Silica fiber composition for use according to claim 1, wherein the silica fiber composition is non-biodegradable.
4. Silica fiber composition for use according to any one of the preceding claims 1 to 3, wherein the wound is not covered with any wound dressing other than the silica fiber composition.

5. Silica fiber composition for use according to claim 1, wherein the silica fiber composition is applied to the tissue as a thin layer, or alternatively, is processed into a powder or dust, and the powder or dust is applied to the tissue, wherein preferably, the powder or dust is mixed or suspended in a topical composition, wherein, preferably, the topical composition is a lotion, ointment, paste, cream, foam, or gel, and/or the topical composition further comprises one or more pharmaceutical or antimicrobial agents, preferably an antibiotic or antiseptic, or an anti-inflammatory agent or immunosuppressant.

6. Silica fiber composition for use according to claim 2, wherein the silica fiber composition is applied to the wound one or four times daily to cover the wound, and generally reapplied when the fibers are no longer visible in the wound.
7. Silica fiber composition for use according to claim 1, wherein the silica fiber composition is prepared by electrospinning a sol-gel.
8. Silica fiber composition for use according to claim 7, wherein the sol-gel is prepared with tetraethyl orthosilicate (TEOS).
9. Silica fiber composition for use according to claim 7, wherein the sol-gel contains 70% to 90% TEOS by weight, 8% to 25% ethanol by weight, an acid catalyst, and the balance water.

10. Silica fiber composition for use according to claim 7, wherein the sol-gel is allowed to transition for at least 2 days under conditions where humidity is within the range of about 40% to about 80%, and the temperature is within the range of 50° F to 90° F.
11. Silica fiber composition for use according to claim 7, wherein the sol-gel is electrospun when the weight is at from 20% to 40% of the starting weight before ripening.

12. Silica fiber composition for use according to claim 7, wherein the sol-gel is electrospun when the production of ethylene vapor is 10% to 20% relative to the peak production of ethylene vapors during ripening.

13. Silica fiber composition for use according to claim 1, wherein the silica fiber composition is applied to a skin lesion, ulcer, preferably a diabetic ulcer or a pressure ulcer, wound, preferably a gangrenous wound or an amputation wound, burn, cut, scrape, blister or pressure sore, or alternatively, wherein the silica fiber composition is applied to a subject having a genetic blistering disease and/or epidermolysis bullosa.

14. Silica fiber composition for use according to claim 1, wherein the tissue has a wound comprising a skin burn, cut, or scrape, and the silica fiber composition is applied in layers in an amount that is sufficient to cover the wound.

15. Silica fiber composition for use according to claim 14, further comprising reapplying the silica fiber composition to the injured tissue once the silica fiber composition is no longer visible on the injured tissue.
